brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Two-storey storage tower for a workbench
requirements.evidence: Build has pieces at level 0 and level 1: piece:0,0,0;half-w and piece:0,0,1;half-w stacked, plus piece:-1,1,0;full with piece:-1,1,1;full and piece:1,-1,0;full with piece:1,-1,1;full providing two full-height columns, joined by snaps snap:0,0,0;half-w, snap:-1,1,0;full, snap:1,-1,0;full.

No drawer parts installed. Sockets for notch drawer frames (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm / hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm-x2) are available at q -1 r0 level 0 and level 1 (s71/s72 and s85 etc.), but no addNotch with drawer frame was applied, so get_build shows zero notch/bay/drawer parts.

finish.summary: Two-storey shell built with three vertical columns spanning levels 0-1, but drawers not yet installed although notch drawer sockets are offered.
